images.scene: A plumber at work in an ordinary apartment kitchen: a man of about 40 with short hair and light stubble, in a plain dark navy work jacket, crouching in front of the open cabinet under the kitchen sink and tightening a leaking pipe joint under the sink with an adjustable wrench. The leak is obvious at a glance: water drips and a thin jet sprays from the joint, drops fall into a blue plastic basin half full of water on the cabinet floor, a wet rag and a small puddle on the floor tiles. He is seen in three-quarter profile from the side, face visible, looking at the pipe, not at the camera. Camera at his eye level, medium shot. Bright soft daylight from a window, light-coloured clean room, fresh lively natural colours, well exposed, not dark, not gloomy. White wall tiles, light kitchen cabinets. The man's head, his hands with the wrench and the dripping pipe are in the upper two thirds of the square frame, horizontally centred; the bottom third of the frame is only floor tiles. Ordinary Russian man, Slavic appearance, everyday look, calm natural concentrated expression, candid documentary photo, not a stock photo, no smile for the camera, no perfect white teeth, no glamour, not a model. Ordinary Russian city apartment. No text, no signs, no logos, no brand names on clothing or packaging.
